create_get_fi_ar_workspace: create a flashinfer allreduce workspace for non-quant patterns with specified world size, rank, token count, hidden dim, dtype, and process group
create_get_fi_ar_quant_workspace: create a flashinfer allreduce quantization fusion workspace using trtllm backend for FP8/FP4 quantized allreduce patterns
run_flashinfer_all_reduce: run flashinfer allreduce on a 2D contiguous CUDA tensor using the FlashInferAllReduce class with a process group and device
build_resolve_fi_ar_backend: build the flashinfer allreduce backend selection by resolving auto, mnnvl, or trtllm based on node count and environment variable
destroy_fi_ar_workspace: destroy and clean up flashinfer allreduce workspaces including both quant and non-quant workspace allocations
